import json, re

upstream = json.loads('''$query_new_cases.message''')
if isinstance(upstream, str):
    try:
        upstream = json.loads(upstream)
    except:
        upstream = {}

cases = upstream.get("cases", [])
errors = upstream.get("errors", [])

# Match field to observable type mapping
FIELD_TO_TYPE = {
    "id_resp_h": "ip",
    "server_name": "fqdn",
    "query": "domain",
    "host": "domain",
    "sha256": "hash"
}

# Per-type analyzer routing (OpenCTI removed, incompatible with v7)
TYPE_TO_ANALYZERS = {
    "ip": ["AbuseIPDB_1_1", "Shodan_Host_1_0"],
    "domain": ["Abuse_Finder_3_0", "GoogleDNS_resolve_1_0_0"],
    "fqdn": ["Abuse_Finder_3_0", "GoogleDNS_resolve_1_0_0"],
    "hash": ["VirusTotal_GetReport_3_1"]
}

# Title format from WF-HACCP-1: [haccp tier1] {match_field}={matched_value} ({provider})
TITLE_RE = re.compile(r"\[haccp tier1\]\s+(\w+)=(.+?)\s+\(([^)]+)\)")

enrichments = []

for case in cases:
    case_id = case.get("case_id", "")
    title = case.get("title", "")
    tags = case.get("tags", [])

    match_field = ""
    matched_value = ""
    provider = ""

    # Try regex on title first
    m = TITLE_RE.search(title)
    if m:
        match_field = m.group(1)
        matched_value = m.group(2).strip()
        provider = m.group(3).strip()
    else:
        # Fallback: extract match_field from tags (e.g., "match_field:id_resp_h")
        for tag in tags:
            if tag.startswith("match_field:"):
                match_field = tag.split(":", 1)[1]
                break
        # Try to extract value from title after = sign
        eq_idx = title.find("=")
        if eq_idx > 0:
            rest = title[eq_idx+1:].strip()
            paren_idx = rest.rfind("(")
            if paren_idx > 0:
                matched_value = rest[:paren_idx].strip()
                provider = rest[paren_idx+1:].rstrip(")")
            else:
                matched_value = rest[:200]

    if not match_field or not matched_value:
        errors.append(f"Could not parse title for case {case_id}: {title[:100]}")
        continue

    obs_type = FIELD_TO_TYPE.get(match_field, "")
    if not obs_type:
        errors.append(f"Unknown match_field {match_field} for case {case_id}")
        continue

    analyzers = TYPE_TO_ANALYZERS.get(obs_type, [])

    enrichments.append({
        "case_id": case_id,
        "title": title[:200],
        "match_field": match_field,
        "matched_value": matched_value[:500],
        "observable_type": obs_type,
        "observable_value": matched_value[:500],
        "analyzers": analyzers,
        "provider": provider
    })

has_cases = "true" if enrichments else "false"

print(json.dumps({
    "has_cases": has_cases,
    "enrichments": enrichments,
    "enrichment_count": len(enrichments),
    "errors": errors
}))

import json

upstream = json.loads('''$run_analyzers.message''')
if isinstance(upstream, str):
    try:
        upstream = json.loads(upstream)
    except:
        upstream = {}

jobs = upstream.get("jobs", [])
job_count = upstream.get("job_count", 0)
errors = upstream.get("errors", [])

thehive_count = sum(1 for j in jobs if j.get("method") == "thehive_connector")
cortex_count = sum(1 for j in jobs if j.get("method") == "cortex_direct")
cases_touched = list(set(j.get("case_id", "") for j in jobs if j.get("case_id")))

summary = (
    f"WF-HACCP-1.1 complete: {job_count} analyzer job(s) submitted "
    f"({thehive_count} via TheHive connector, {cortex_count} via Cortex direct) "
    f"across {len(cases_touched)} case(s). "
    f"{len(errors)} error(s)."
)

print(json.dumps({
    "summary": summary,
    "job_count": job_count,
    "thehive_connector_count": thehive_count,
    "cortex_direct_count": cortex_count,
    "cases_touched": cases_touched,
    "errors": errors
}))

name: WF-HACCP-1.1: Cortex Enrichment on Tier1 Cases
description: Cron-triggered (every 5min, offset 2min from WF-HACCP-1). Queries TheHive for new tier1 cases without observables, parses title to extract indicator type+value, creates observables, submits Cortex analyzer jobs via TheHive connector (fire and forget). Per-type routing: AbuseIPDB+Shodan for IPs, Abuse_Finder+GoogleDNS for domains, VirusTotal for hashes. No Ollama, no Discord.
